blocks.text: The 29 October results briefing at K-Kampus is the strongest room. Kesko's own calendar puts the CEO and all three division Presidents in one place to take questions, and the Dahl integration is the live topic. Velho cannot get into that room as a speaker, so the practical move is a 30-minute coffee nearby the week after, or a side breakfast request near Slush on 18-19 November, where Kesko is not confirmed. Attending the results briefing itself is a press-and-analyst event, so check whether Velho can register before assuming access.

blocks.label: Pre-event note
blocks.text: Hi [Name], Kesko's Dahl integration is a lot to run at once, and we noticed the Manhattan warehouse rollout alongside it. Would you have 15 minutes at Slush on 18 or 19 November, or at a coffee near K-Kampus after the 29 October results? I'd like to ask what gets handled manually today. Will you be attending either?

blocks.label: Walk-up line
blocks.text: We noticed Kesko is bringing Dahl in while running the warehouse rollout, so I wanted to ask where the manual handoffs are hurting most.

Unconfirmed items to verify before use: (a) Kesko attendance or speaking slot at Slush 2026 is not confirmed in any source; (b) the Slush dates appear as 18-19 Nov in several listings but one source says 25-26 Nov, so confirm the official dates; (c) the 29 October teleconference link and registration should be checked on the Kesko site; (d) the 30 October EGM is a shareholder meeting, so attendance is limited to shareholders and proxies unless Kesko confirms otherwise; (e) TED tender matches in the dossier are name matches only and are not used here; (f) no Velho-specific event attendance has been agreed, so the drafts ask rather than assume.
